note: Kentucky State Parks campground on a ridge above Barren River Lake. The southwest loop's west pads look down an open mown slope to a lake arm and the campground's boat ramp, and site 79A sees the lake through the trees; the rest are wooded. The long pull-throughs run up to about 119 ft. Golf course, marina and beach in the park. --Claude
summary: Kept. 99 RV sites (9 full hookup 50A, 90 W/E 30A; 60 pull-throughs) + 2 tent; W/E $29/$37/$40 holiday, full hookup $34/$46/$53; showers, restrooms, dump; season Mar 15 - Nov 15 (closed now until Mar 14 2027). Lakeview KEPT (open slope ~110-140 m to the lake below the SW loop; site 79A photo shows the lake). Policy-row fee copies cleared; website fix.
flags: WATERFRONT lakeview KEPT after a hard check. Barren River Lake summer pool 552 ft (168.2 m). The SW loop's west pads (~36.8513,-86.0667, 185.4 m on 3DEP) sit ~17 m above pool, with an open mown field falling to the lake arm and campground boat ramp; the summer-pool line is ~110-140 m away (3DEP 170.5 m at 36.8505,-86.0675, 164.9 m at 36.8499,-86.0680). Leaf-off Esri imagery shows the open line of sight. RA's official photo of site 079A shows the lake and far shore through the trees. RA tags every site 'Near Water - no', and no pad is within ~50 m of the water, so no front value. Suggested evidence: 'Esri + 3DEP 2026-11-24: SW loop west pads ~36.8513,-86.0667 at 185 m, 17 m above summer pool (168.2 m), open mown slope ~110-140 m to the lake arm; RA site photo 079A shows the lake through the trees; no pad within 50 m = lakeview'.
